### Donaldson Company to Present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference


06 November 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s204.q4cdn.com/581939372/files/doc_news/Donaldson-Company-to-Present-at-the-Baird-2026-Global-Industrial-Conference-2026.pdf)


MINNEAPOLIS--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


Donaldson Company, Inc. (NYSE: DCI), a leading worldwide provider of innovative filtration products and solutions, today announced Rich Lewis, president and chief executive officer, will present at the Baird 2026 Global Industrial Conference in Chicago, Illinois on Wednesday, November 11, beginning at 2:20 p.m. CT.


**About Donaldson Company**


Founded in 1915, Donaldson (NYSE: DCI) is a global leader in technology-led filtration products and solutions, serving a broad range of industries and advanced markets. Diverse, skilled employees at over 150 locations on six continents partner with customers – from small business owners to R&D organizations and the world’s biggest OEM brands. Donaldson solves complex filtration challenges through three primary segments: Mobile Solutions, Industrial Solutions and Life Sciences. Additional information is available at[www.Donaldson.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.Donaldson.com&esheet=54635140&newsitemid=20261106830216&lan=en-US&anchor=www.Donaldson.com&index=1&md5=a2abda3b768ccca91bba8cb70c6f9797) .
